cells.quote: Employing GLMMs on single-trial accuracy data, we identified a significant interaction effect between training session and group (OR = 1.47, 95% CI [1.25, 1.72],p < 0.001), demonstrating differential improvements in speech-in-noise (SIN) comprehension from pre- to post-training across groups. Specifically, the experimental group exhibited significantly greater improvements in post-training performance compared to the active control group.
